In the beginning, there was nothing.

Then, there was a man. Alone in the void of void, an unreality where nothing existed, not even nothing itself. Primal forces floated around him, and yet he was colder than cold itself. *so cold…* He was the first in this realm, yet he was old, older than the entirety of existence, older than reality and even the concept of *something*. Stars in his eyes from a dead age, memories of galaxies swept away like sand off glass. A sole survivor from a doomed land, no more than a whisper in the mythos lost to the ages. He saw it fall around him, and he saw his mind float away. His memories like ashes to the wind, all he remembered was the sky like crystals in the heavens - ashes wiped from an altar, sacrifices to ***who***? None mattered now, oblivion made all equal - though he, and he only, had survived oblivion. *Why?* he shouted to the everlasting dark - as if expecting to find an answer from the void. He had gone mad long ago - a jester to the torment of the realm. One name came to him… Orocryx. It fit. The man whose name would be lost to eternity, the man now called Orocryx, felt around him. He would bring back his memory - he would find what destroyed his home and kill it. This realm was a new chance, an opportunity to seize fate and **kill it**.

With his hands, he grabbed the primordial forces that formed all that existed around him. Naught but wisps, they formed the basis of what would become his redemption. He felt the power coursing through him, and the… **ACK**. The arc of power crossed his heart and *changed* him. Power flooded along his veins and suffused what would be declared by any sane medical practitioner as his cold corpse, and the change happened. His eyes were closed, but his eye *opened*. A vertical slit on line with the bridge of his nose deepened and then snapped open, revealing a crystalline third eye that dashed from focus to focus, rolling and boiling and shining like a star in its infancy. He could see everything, however little there was to see. And the **power**, power divine yet born of the primal energies, he felt like he could do anything and everything, yet he knew to not be hasty. Bide his time.

And so, he waited.

In the dark.

Orocryx, The Mad God, The First, The Lidless Eye.
